svg.title: Instance contrast shown on real signals
svg.desc: Four recorded waveforms share one frozen instant t. Series one is cropped into two overlapping views that both contain t, producing two embeddings that form the positive pair, while the other three series at the same instant produce impostor embeddings that are pushed away.
svg.text: The batch: 4 recordings, one shared frozen instant
Same instant t in all four recordings
Series 1 only: both crops contain t
Meanwhile, the other three recordings at the very same instant t:
Positive is decided by bookkeeping, not by the model:
same series index i, same global timestamp t, other view. Nothing else.
